### 📓 Docs Drift Check
This PR changes **1** package(s): `@objectstack/cli`, touching **2** documentable anchor(s).

**16** hand-written doc(s) name something this change touched — list omitted above 15 rows. Re-derive on the tree named below: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 54d6726c09019bd1d9da29b7aee3fb9e907dbb0a`.

⛔ **6** release-owned page(s) also affected — read-only, see AGENTS.md Documentation Guardrails.

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- **1** name(s) were too generic to anchor anything (single lowercase words)
- the SDK route bridge reached **69** of **252** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **183** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **183**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **59** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **124** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **40** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 54d6726c09019bd1d9da29b7aee3fb9e907dbb0a` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `024ad38e6d935f52d27d59063074547d385cbc23` — the merge of head `e0157a8872ec5e927cd779d190b22642e1508766` into base `54d6726c09019bd1d9da29b7aee3fb9e907dbb0a`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin 024ad38e6d935f52d27d59063074547d385cbc23 && git checkout 024ad38e6d935f52d27d59063074547d385cbc23
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin 54d6726c09019bd1d9da29b7aee3fb9e907dbb0a e0157a8872ec5e927cd779d190b22642e1508766 && git checkout -B drift-repro 54d6726c09019bd1d9da29b7aee3fb9e907dbb0a && git merge --no-ff e0157a8872ec5e927cd779d190b22642e1508766

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 54d6726c09019bd1d9da29b7aee3fb9e907dbb0a
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

> Advisory only, and a **precision-first** one (#9192): a page is listed because it names a
> symbol, wire route or SDK method this diff touched — not because it mentions a changed
> package. Each row says which anchor put it there, so a wrong row is reportable rather than
> merely annoying. To re-verify, run the `docs-accuracy-audit` workflow scoped to these files:
> `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs 54d6726c09019bd1d9da29b7aee3fb9e907dbb0a` → pass the list as
> `args.docs`, on the commit named under **Which tree this was computed on**.

**Landing: NOT with the current red.** See "The red check" below. Route A (recommended) moves the head and owes a delta read.

## 席位核对

**Shape and gates.** `l1-face --pr 37595`: 11 items ok, 2 flags (both judged below). Check-runs at 95d0446c0d: 60 success, 11 expected skip, 0 pending, 1 failure (`Scaffold with repo dist`). `Lint & Repo Gates` and `TypeScript Type Check` both success. Draft, base `main`, first line `Fixes #37503`, no closing keyword next to another card. 11 files, +107/-57. Not governed. `Clause-②: no` · `Metadata-protocol: none`. No contract face: the only `packages/spec` file is a `.test.ts` comment, no governed path, no `Clause-②: yes`, no narrowing. So no L2 is owed.

**Changeset flag: not a gap.** l1-face lists `create-objectstack` (2 files) and `@objectstack/spec` (1 file) without entries. All three are test-file comments. `create-objectstack` ships `dist, README.md, CHANGELOG.md`, and spec ships `src/**/*.zod.ts` and not `*.test.ts`, so nothing published moves. The `@objectstack/cli` patch covers the generator output change.

**Fixes is right.** All four items of the card are in the diff.
1. `os g object` now writes `fieldGroups: [{ key: 'details', label: 'Details', fields: ['name'] }]` after the field map, with no per-field `group`. That matches the starter: the blank template's `company.object.ts` / `contact.object.ts` carry zero `group: '` lines on main and place every field through `fields` lists. The #32153 pin keeps its name, and its expectations now assert `fields: ['name']` and `group` undefined, plus the e2e text. The ablation positive control is in the report: generate.ts reverted, the pin fails "expected undefined to deeply equal [ name ]".
2. cli.mdx `os compile` / `os info` transcripts are rebuilt from a real run. The counts agree with the fixture the callout names: 3 objects; 7 + 7 + 4 = 18 fields; 1 app; 3 views (two starter lists plus the ticket view); 1 action; 0 plugins. `check:docs-transcript-drift` exit 0 per the report.
3. Getting-started callouts: `npm view create-objectstack dist-tags` read now answers `latest: 18.6.0`, so "installs 18.6.0 today" is true today. The `blank` row is corrected.
4. The stale `note` comments in the four named test files are corrected.

**Docs and changeset, sentence by sentence.** cli.mdx line 30: "the starter's companies and contacts" is true. The callout ("seven-field `my_app_company` and `my_app_contact` objects, a list view of each and the `main` app, and no plugins"; "`1 Apps`: the starter's own"; "a section with nothing in it still prints its zero row"; "one `form-view-internal-not-loaded` warning … the transcript leaves both out") is consistent with the transcript and the fixture. Leaving the two warning lines out is acceptable because the callout states it, and the warning itself is now carried (below). Both getting-started callouts are true as of this read; their removal at 19.0 is owed, see #37615. Changeset: the four sentences hold against the generate.ts hunk and the starter.

**Dev deviations.** The two WIP pushes went out before overlap-check ran. It ran clean before every later push, and the PR is mergeable against main. Accepted; recorded here. The e2e assertion edit is covered by the claim's "generator tests whose expected output changes". The extra cli.mdx and template-row corrections are the same stale-template defect in the same files. Accepted.

**Out-of-scope findings.**
- class-a (`os compile` on the Build-with-Claude-Code ticket view prints `form-view-internal-not-loaded`, while the page says the form is where `description` is entered): filed on #37088 as a same-mechanism comment, 7196578128 (open, unclaimed, docs teaching internal forms; its Done-when grep misses a `form:` member on a docs page). #37422 touches that page only for the rule count.
- `os init -t app` still writes a per-field `group`: filed #37615 (review follow-ups of this PR), item 1.
- Removing the "18.6.0 today" callouts at 19.0: filed #37615, item 2.
- The blank template comment vs `deriveFieldGroupLayout`, and the validating-metadata.mdx summary: dropped. Both are a read-only inference with no measured wrong output.

## The red check

`Scaffold with repo dist` fails at step 7 "Validate and build the generated project", first error `✗ ObjectSchema.create('e2e_app_company'): unknown key(s) — color.` (job 139980278781). The cause is #37441's: during pre mode the generated project installs published 18.6.0, which refuses shapes main ships. #37441 is `pm:on-hold` (ruling 7194715376).

It does **not** meet SKILL.md's third case. All three conditions must hold, and the first fails: `scaffold-e2e.yml`'s source does not describe this red as by design on pushed branches. It is a known broken gate with a fix on hold. The merge-base exception (contract-review.md: same-signature red on the base) cannot be read either: the workflow runs on `pull_request` (path-filtered) and `schedule` only, so main has no run of this job to compare. #37428 landed with this red on the maintainer's own word for that PR, which does not carry over to this one.

What triggers the job here is only the two comment-only files under `packages/create-objectstack/**` (the workflow's path filter; the PR touches no `docker/**` and not the workflow).

- **Route A (recommended):** split the two comment-only test files, `packages/create-objectstack/src/blank-template-console-disclosure.test.ts` and `starter-comments-self-contained.test.ts`, into their own small PR that lands after #37441 fixes the gate. This PR switches its first line to `Part of #37503` and lands green now. The second PR carries `Fixes #37503`, and the card stays `pm:dispatched` until it merges. New head ⇒ send it for a delta read.
- **Route B:** keep the PR whole and park it until #37441 lands and the job goes green on a re-run.
- Landing with the red needs the maintainer's own word on this PR, as #37428 had. Per the standing rule that goes through Fable and the seat. I do not recommend it: route A costs one small PR.

### ⛔ merge queue 构建失败 — 先分诊，再决定要不要重排

队列构建 [45857731693](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/actions/runs/45857731693) 红了。队列跑的是**全量**套件（PR 侧 CI 只跑 affected 子集），
所以失败的测试可能在本 PR 没碰过的包里 —— 那不是重排能修的。每次盲目重排都会让排在后面的所有 PR 重建一轮。

**分类：`failure`** —— 按下面的日志分诊。

**失败的 job（日志抽取，best effort）：**

- **[Test Core (10/10)](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/actions/runs/45857731693/job/140041836835)** — 失败步骤: Run this shard's tests

  ```
  @objectstack/plugin-security:test:  FAIL  src/insert-check-post-image.test.ts > [#16608] insert on driver-sqlite-wasm (:memory:) — the check judges the row that will be stored > the scoping field land
    ↳ 失败原因: @objectstack/plugin-security:test: Error: Test timed out in 5000ms.
  ```

> `↳ 失败原因` 是判读的关键：**超时**（`Test timed out in …` / `Hook timed out in …`）多半是负载/时序，不是本 PR 的回归；
> **断言**（`AssertionError: …`）才指向真实的行为改变。两者的 `FAIL` 行长得一模一样，只有这一行能区分。
>
> ⚠️ **断言这一侧有一类例外，判据是断言在测什么，不是它是不是 `AssertionError`。** 断言的对象是**产品行为**（一个值、一个形状、一次拒收）⇒ 照上面读：真实的行为改变，去查，⛔ 不要重排掉；
> 断言的对象是**这次实验自身的有效性前提**（跑完的耗时、负载下的先后、任何只在时间预算内才成立的条件）⇒ 它跟**超时**是同一类，同样对负载敏感，重排一次是合法的判别手段。
> 识别是机械的：断言的消息或它比较的值本身点名了一段**时长、一个时间戳、一个耗时计数**。实测过的一对 —— `AssertionError: SecurityPlugin.init() ran: expected false to be true` 测的是产品行为（真回归）；
> `AssertionError: this run took over a second, so second-precision stamps could have differed too: expected 1006 to be less than 1000` 测的是实验前提：它守护的那条不变式当时是绿的，同一个 head 原样重排一次即成功。
> 穿着 `AssertionError` 外衣的时间测量，仍然是时间测量。（⛔ 这只改「怎么读一次红」，不改「哪些测试可以重排」——后者由别处管。）

**跨 PR 相同签名（24h，按失败测试文件聚合）：**

- `src/insert-check-post-image.test.ts` — 24h 窗口内只有本 PR 撞到过，暂不汇总（再有一个不同 PR 撞到就会自动开汇总 issue）。
- ⚠️ 24h 评论账本**没读完**（超过 5 页仍未读到窗口尽头），所以上面的「不同 PR 数」是**下界**，不是全量。

**历史信号：**
- 本 PR 过去 24h 无队列失败记录（首次）。
- 过去 24h 队列共有 12 个失败构建（不含本次）。

**分诊清单：**
1. 失败测试在本 PR 改动的包里 → 真回归，修 PR。
2. 失败测试与本 PR 无关 → 看上面的「跨 PR 相同签名」；已有汇总 issue ⇒ flaky/环境问题实锤，去那张 issue 上谈，修好前重排只会再烧一轮全队列。
3. 两者都不是 → 可能与同组 PR 语义冲突；等前面的 PR 落地或失败出队后再重排一次即可，不要连续重排。
